summary:
The Zamboanga Peninsula stands under the national framework of the Philippines; the national legal position, document rules and protection machinery are carried by the country record. Within the peninsula, the one region-specific protection instrument identified is a SOGIE anti-discrimination ordinance enacted by Zamboanga City, the regional centre, in 2020. It sets the local legal floor for visitors and residents inside the city.

No trans-specific safety finding, incident, prosecution or enforcement record for the Zamboanga Peninsula appears in the source inventory. The peninsula's other provinces and municipalities are not recorded as having their own anti-discrimination instruments, so outside Zamboanga City the local floor is whatever national law provides.
tangentialFactors:
The Zamboanga City ordinance is a municipal instrument, so its reach ends at the city boundary. A visitor moving between the city and the peninsula's other provinces and municipalities passes between different local legal floors, and the inventory records no equivalent instrument for those areas.

The inventory contains no regional enforcement data, complaint outcomes or police conduct findings for the peninsula, so no comparison between the peninsula and other parts of the Philippines can be drawn from it.
localsOnly: Residents of Zamboanga City have a local SOGIE anti-discrimination ordinance, enacted in 2020, as a complaint avenue that does not depend on national legislation; it reaches trans residents as well as gay and lesbian residents. Residents elsewhere in the peninsula have no recorded local instrument and rely on national law.
outOfScopeNotes:
The text, penalties, implementing office and complaint outcomes of the Zamboanga City ordinance are not sourced in the inventory. No regional incident, prosecution or custodial data for the peninsula is recorded.

National-level material in the source inventory, including legislation, national violence data, custodial practice and ordinances in other parts of the Philippines, is not region-specific and is carried by the country record.
